purpose: Teach: 属する/従う/密接/超過/所在/着手/急増/取り上げる

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 業界団体に、本気で、絶対、属する、絶対、企業として、絶対、お務めを、絶対、果たしましょう
lines.en: We must commit ourselves seriously to fulfilling our corporate obligations to industry associations, without exception.
lines.style: Formal, measured opening. Clear authority. Even pace, deliberate articulation on each key phrase. Confident posture in the voice—this is non-negotiable.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。コンプライアンスに、本気で、絶対、従う、絶対、徹底しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We are committed to thorough compliance with the utmost seriousness, and we appreciate your guidance.
lines.style: Respectful affirmation. Slightly formal register—the tone of someone confirming alignment. Steady, unhurried pace. Slight nod in the voice on key commitments.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 仕入れ先と、本気で、絶対、密接、絶対、な、絶対、関係、絶対、続けましょう
lines.en: We should maintain close, strengthened relationships with our suppliers going forward.
lines.style: Directive but not harsh. Clear intention. Moderate tempo with slight weight on 'maintain' and 'strengthened.' Professional but approachable—this is collaborative, not dictatorial.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。広告費、本気で、絶対、超過、絶対、注意、絶対、しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We are being vigilant about advertisement spending and have put careful controls in place.
lines.style: Calm briefing tone. Competent and thorough—the voice of someone who has already thought this through. Steady rhythm. Slight emphasis on 'careful controls' to show due diligence.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 責任の、本気で、絶対、所在、絶対、社員に、絶対、説明、絶対、しましょう
lines.en: Let's make sure we explain clearly to our staff where responsibility lies.
lines.style: Direct but collegial. A gentle push forward. Measured pace with slight emphasis on 'clearly.' Not commanding—inviting shared accountability.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新プロジェクトに、本気で、絶対、着手、絶対、いたしました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We have already begun work on the new project and appreciate the opportunity.
lines.style: Positive update delivered with quiet confidence. Even pacing. Warm undertone—showing initiative without overstatement. Professional optimism.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: お問合せ、本気で、絶対、急増、絶対、サポート、絶対、強化しましょう
lines.en: Customer inquiries have surged significantly. We need to strengthen our support systems immediately.
lines.style: Alert but not panicked. Slightly elevated energy to match the urgency. Clear articulation. The tone of someone identifying a problem and already thinking through solutions.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員の声を、本気で、絶対、取り上げる、絶対、社内報、絶対、出しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We've been actively featuring employee voices in our internal communications, and we're grateful for the platform to do so.
lines.style: Closing affirmation with warmth. Slightly slower pace than previous updates—making space for the personal touch. Pride in the initiative. Genuine appreciation in the final phrase.
